test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 11 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select 'No substitution required'.

__Keep pets__ can be very comforting for most people.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Keeping pets'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given sentence the **main verb **is **comforting.**
 
• **The underlined part is not a verb but the subject of the sentence. **
 
• So, instead of the **verb keep**, we need to use the **gerund keeping** to make the underlined part correct. 
 
• The noun **pets **does not need substitution.
 
• Thus, the underlined part **keep pets **need to be substituted by **keeping pets. **
 
• This makes **option 4 **the correct answer.
